lines.chest: A chest nobody was meant to find: %d gold.
lines.pad: The floor lights up under you, and you are somewhere else.

biomes.name: THE OLD HALLS
biomes.line: Long straight halls, cut by someone who cared about corners.

biomes.name: THE UNDERCROFT
biomes.line: Rooms upon rooms, built in pieces that nearly fit.

biomes.name: THE WET CAVES
biomes.line: No walls here, only where the rock stopped. Keep your bearings.
